description: Explain what an Airlock finding kind means, why it is dangerous, how to fix it (with example SQL), and which other findings are related. Pure lookup — no database connection needed. Use this after get_findings or audit_supabase_rls to understand a specific finding before fixing it. Supported kinds: rls_disabled, permissive_true, anon_unscoped, authenticated_unscoped, write_unchecked, write_unscoped, update_using_unscoped, or_branch_unscoped, helper_scoped, security_definer, anon_executes_definer, definer_search_path_mutable, view_bypasses_rls, matview_exposed, public_bucket, realtime_exposure, cross_tenant_read_leak, cross_tenant_write_leak, cross_tenant_delete_leak, bypassrls_role, owner_bypasses_rls.

finding_kind.description: The finding kind string from an audit result (e.g. 'rls_disabled', 'permissive_true', 'cross_tenant_read_leak').

name: explain_finding
